newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU must follow scientists on gene maize - Fischler.
newsitem.headline: EU must follow scientists on gene maize - Fischler.

text.p: The European Union (EU) must follow scientific advice on Ciba-Geigy AG's gene-modified maize, said EU Farm Commissioner Franz Fischler.
Commission officials have said three EU scientific committees have raised no significant concerns about the maize, clearing the way for the European Commission to approve it on Wednesday.
"There's not much alternative than to follow the scientific advice," Fischler told Reuters following a two-day meeting of EU farm ministers ending late on Tuesday.
The farm ministers did not discuss gene maize.
The Commission was discussing whether to authorise the marketing of genetically-modified maize at its weekly meeting.

But Environment Commissioner Ritt Bjerregaard, supported by the Health and Consumer Affairs commissioners, was likely to insist on monitoring of maize shipments and some form of special labelling, Commission officials said.
